title: The Share of a Snowsports School Booking's Value Added to a Change of Date
content:
A share of the booking's value is added to the figure charged for a change of date on a Snowsports School booking, because a place worth more costs more to move.

**Clause 1.** The share of the booking's value that is added to the fee is fixed only after the school account carries the tuition entry due for the booking.

**Clause 2.** Where the tuition standing reaches the product's session price, the large booking share is added, and it stands at 4 percentage points. Where the tuition standing is above nothing but short of the product's session price, the small booking share is added, and it stands at 2 percentage points. Where no tuition stands on the booking, no booking share is added, and the share stands at 0 percentage points.

## The session prices the bands turn on

| Product | Session price (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 179.00 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 259.00 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 309.00 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 129.00 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 549.00 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 949.00 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 459.00 |

## Both sides of each boundary

Take a booking of the Six-Week Development Programme, whose session price is 129.00 USD.

| Tuition standing on the booking | Share added |
| --- | --- |
| 749.00 USD | 4 percentage points |
| exactly 129.00 USD | 4 percentage points |
| 128.00 USD | 2 percentage points |
| 1.00 USD | 2 percentage points |
| nothing standing | 0 percentage points |

## A reading on hypothetical figures

Where the value is reckoned on 150.00 USD and the tuition standing reaches the product's session price, 4 percentage points of that figure is 6.00 USD. Where the tuition standing is above nothing but short of the session price, 2 percentage points of it is 3.00 USD. Where no tuition stands on the booking, nothing is added on this count whatever the value is reckoned on.
